features: Bright Large Style Studio East Facing
Underfloor Heating Included in Service Charge
Great Transport Links Inc Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Beautifully presented, high spec, large bright east facing studio, fully furbished by Thomson Brothers. Type F2A, located on the 2nd floor. Full height width floor to ceiling glass sliding door/windows leading to a balcony. Air conditioning installed. Generous built in storage. Underfloor heating included in the service charge. Lifts. Use of residents’ gardens. 24hr car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London.
The Barbican Estate Grade II listed, includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations (offering direct access to both Heathrow, Gatwick and Stanstead airports) only a short walk away. Also in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate.
No onward chain
